how.title: How secrets work
how.step1: Add a secret once. The organization provides one shared value, or each user adds their own.
how.step2: Choose which agents can use it, here or in an agent's settings. A project can set it for every task in that project.
how.step3Before: When a run starts, the agent finds it as an environment variable, such as
how.step3After: . The value is never shown again.
